blocks.text: Architecting a High-Performance Cloud ERP Platform for a Global Fashion House
Apparel
Client
A global apparel production leader with 20+ production locations worldwide, catering to leading brands.
Ambition
To migrate their mission-critical, on-premise ERP system to a modern, high-performance, and resilient cloud platform.
Outcome
Architected and migrated their ERP database to a managed cloud PaaS solution, which eliminated downtime, provided a 99.99% SLA, and saved significant upfront investment in DR infrastructure.
The Ambition
A global apparel production leader with 20+ production locations worldwide, catering to leading brands.
The Challenge

Their on-premise ERP database had no high availability or disaster recovery, a massive risk for their global operations. Building out a proper DR site would incur a huge capital investment. Furthermore, the on-premise deployment was prone to performance bottlenecks, and the overhead of maintaining, scaling, and patching the database was a constant drain on IT resources.
The Architectural Blueprint

As an early adopter of technology, the client's ambition was to ensure their core ERP system, used by over 1000 people globally, was running on a platform that was as modern and agile as their business. They needed a solution that could guarantee high availability and performance without the high cost and complexity of a traditional on-premise setup.
Ambition, Realized

Moving to the cloud was a remarkable turning point. The 99.99% SLA resolved the critical issue of service availability, and the built-in HA and DR features saved the customer several lakhs of rupees in upfront investment. Since the underlying infrastructure was fully managed by the cloud provider, the need for an internal infrastructure management team was eliminated. The user experience improved manifold, and the cloud solution provided a scalable, resilient platform for their continued growth.
Key Business Impact
Achieved 99.99% SLA for a Mission-Critical ERP System
Eliminated the Need for a Costly On-Premise DR Site
Reduced IT Management Overhead with a PaaS Solution
Improved User Experience & Application Performance
Back to Happy Customer Back to Happy Customer
